annotation.title_clean: REGIONAL DIALOGUE ON AI POLICIES IN LATIN AMERICA AND THE CARIBBEAN
annotation.title_en: Regional Dialogue on AI Policies in Latin America and the Caribbean
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Inter-American Development Bank (IDB); Ministry of Science, Innovation, Technology and Telecommunications of Costa Rica
annotation.summary_en: Agenda and background for a two-day IDB-hosted regional policy dialogue (San José, Costa Rica, 4–5 December 2025) among Latin American and Caribbean digital authorities on AI policy maturity, regulation models and accelerating responsible AI adoption in the public sector. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Convenes LAC government AI authorities to assess AI policy maturity and debate an adoption roadmap
Frames AI policy as balancing rights and ethics with innovation and adoption
Sessions cover AI regulation models, public sector impact and public-private collaboration
Includes subregional working groups and a closed-door session of AI authorities
